sourceDate.text: 元叉當權至靈太后反政前

units.zh: 盧同 張烈
units.en: Lu Tong; Zhang Lie
units.literal: Lu Tong; Zhang Lie

units.zh: 盧同，字叔倫，范陽涿人，盧玄之族孫。
units.en: Lu Tong, whose style name was Shulun, came from Zhuo in Fanyang and was a descendant of Lu Xuan's clan.
units.literal: Lu Tong, style name Shulun, was a man of Zhuo in Fanyang, a clan grandson of Lu Xuan.

units.zh: 父輔，字顯元，本州別駕。
units.en: His father Fu, styled Xianyuan, served as provincial aide.
units.literal: His father Fu, style name Xianyuan, was Separate Carriage of this province.

units.zh: 同身長八尺，容貌魁偉，善於處世。
units.en: Tong stood eight chi tall, with a towering presence, and was adept in worldly affairs.
units.literal: Tong was eight chi in height, his appearance imposing and grand, and skilled in dealing with the world.

units.zh: 太和中，起家北海王詳國常侍。
units.en: During the Taihe reign he began his career as a household attendant in the household of Prince Xiang of Beihai.
units.literal: In the Taihe era he first entered service as a household retainer of the state of Prince Xiang of Beihai.

units.zh: 稍遷司空祭酒、昌黎太守。
units.en: He was soon promoted to Libationer of the Works and Grand Administrator of Changli.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to Libationer of the Minister of Works and Grand Administrator of Changli.

units.zh: 尋為營州長史，仍帶郡。
units.en: Before long he was appointed Chief Clerk of Yingzhou, retaining concurrent charge of the commandery.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he became Chief Clerk of Ying Province, still holding the commandery as well.

units.zh: 入除河南尹丞，遷太尉屬。
units.en: He was summoned to the capital as Assistant Intendant of Henan, then promoted to an aide under the Grand Commandant.
units.literal: He entered the capital and was appointed Assistant to the Intendant of Henan, then transferred to an aide post under the Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 會豫州城民白早生反，都督中山王英、尚書邢巒等討之，詔同為軍司。
units.en: When the townspeople of Yuzhou under Bai Zaosheng rose in revolt, Prince Ying of Zhongshan as commander-in-chief, Minister Xing Luan, and others marched against them; Tong was ordered to serve as army aide.
units.literal: It happened that the city people of Yuzhou, Bai Zaosheng, rebelled; the Commander-in-Chief Prince Ying of Zhongshan, the Minister Xing Luan, and others attacked them, and an edict appointed Tong as Army Aide.

units.zh: 事平，除冀州鎮東府長史。
units.en: After the rebellion was suppressed, he was made Chief Clerk of the Eastern Pacification headquarters in Jizhou.
units.literal: When the affair was settled, he was appointed Chief Clerk of the Eastern Pacification Headquarters in Jizhou.

units.zh: 遭父憂解任。
units.en: He resigned upon his father's death.
units.literal: He met with his father's bereavement and left office.

units.zh: 後除司空諮議參軍，兼司馬，為營構東宮都將。
units.en: He was later appointed Consulting Army Aide under the Minister of Works, also serving as Major, and named chief commander for building the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: Later he was appointed Consulting Army Aide to the Minister of Works, concurrently Major, and made Chief Commander for constructing the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 延昌中，秦州民反，詔同兼通直常侍，持節慰諭之，多所降下。
units.en: During the Yan-chang era, when the people of Qinzhou rebelled, Tong was ordered to serve concurrently as Regular Attendant and, bearing imperial credentials, to console and instruct them; many groups surrendered.
units.literal: In the Yan-chang era the people of Qinzhou rebelled; an edict made Tong concurrently Regular Attendant of Direct Communication, bearing credentials to console and instruct them, and many submitted.

units.zh: 還轉尚書右丞，進號輔國將軍，以父諱不拜，改授龍驤。
units.en: After returning he became Right Assistant Director in the Masters of Writing and was advanced to General Who Assists the State; because the title conflicted with his father's name he declined it and was reassigned as Dragon Cavalry General.
units.literal: On his return he was transferred to Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing, advanced in title to General Who Assists the State; because of his father's taboo name he did not accept the appointment and was instead given Dragon Cavalry General.

units.zh: 熙平初，轉左丞，加征虜將軍。
units.en: At the opening of the Xiping reign he was moved to Left Assistant Director and additionally named General Who Captures the Barbarians.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Xiping era he was transferred to Left Assistant Director and given the additional title General Who Captures the Barbarians.

units.zh: 時相州刺史奚康生徵民歲調，皆七八十尺，以邀奉公之譽。
units.en: At that time Xi Kangsheng, Inspector of Xiangzhou, collected the annual levy from the people in bolts of seventy or eighty chi each, seeking a reputation for scrupulous devotion to the state.
units.literal: At that time the Inspector of Xiangzhou, Xi Kangsheng, levied the people's annual tribute in lengths all of seventy or eighty chi, to win a reputation for devoted public service.

units.zh: 部內患之，同於歲祿官給長絹。
units.en: The people under his jurisdiction resented this; Tong, from the year's official salary, had long bolts of silk issued as stipends.
units.literal: Those within his jurisdiction were distressed by this; Tong, in the year's salary, had officials issue long bolts of silk as stipends.

units.zh: 同乃舉按康生度外徵調。
units.en: Tong then impeached Kangsheng for collecting levies beyond the statutory quota.
units.literal: Tong thereupon brought charges and investigated Kangsheng's levies beyond the prescribed measure.

units.zh: 書奏，詔科康生之罪，兼褒同在公之績。
units.en: When the memorial reached the throne, an edict convicted Kangsheng and at the same time commended Tong's service to the public good.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, an edict assessed Kangsheng's crime and also praised Tong's public achievements.

units.zh: 肅宗世，朝政稍衰，人多竊冒軍功。
units.en: During Emperor Suzong's reign, court governance weakened, and many men fraudulently claimed military merit.
units.literal: In the age of Emperor Suzong, court governance gradually declined, and many people usurped military merit fraudulently.

units.zh: 同閱吏部勳書，因加檢覆，覈得竊階者三百餘人。
units.en: Tong examined the Ministry of Personnel's merit registers and, on further audit, identified more than three hundred who had stolen rank.
units.literal: Tong reviewed the Ministry of Personnel's merit records and, adding further inspection and verification, found more than three hundred who had stolen ranks.

units.zh: 同乃表言：
units.en: Tong then memorialized the throne as follows:
units.literal: Tong thereupon submitted a memorial saying:

units.zh: 竊見吏部勳簿，多皆改換。
units.en: I have observed that the Ministry's merit registers have largely been altered or replaced.
units.literal: Your subject has observed that the Ministry of Personnel's merit registers have for the most part been altered and replaced.

units.zh: 乃校中兵奏按，並復乖舛。
units.en: When checked against the Central Army bureau's submitted investigations, they again failed to agree.
units.literal: When they were checked against the Central Army's submitted investigations, they were again at variance.

units.zh: 臣聊爾揀練，已得三百餘人，明知隱而未露者，動有千數。
units.en: In a preliminary review I have already found more than three hundred cases; those still concealed must number in the thousands.
units.literal: Your subject, in a cursory sorting and review, has already found more than three hundred; those plainly hidden and not yet exposed must number in the thousands.

units.zh: 愚謂罪雖恩免，猶須刊定。
units.en: I hold that even if offenses are pardoned by imperial grace, the records must still be corrected.
units.literal: This fool believes that although the crimes may be forgiven by grace, they still must be corrected and fixed in the record.

units.zh: 請遣一都令史與令僕省事各一人，總集吏部、中兵二局勳簿，對勾奏按。
units.en: I ask that one chief clerk and one secretariat aide each be sent to assemble the merit registers of the Personnel and Central Army bureaus and cross-check them against the submitted investigations.
units.literal: I request that one chief clerk and one secretariat aide from the Masters of Writing and Works be dispatched to gather together the merit registers of the Ministry of Personnel and the Central Army bureaus and cross-check them against submitted investigations.

units.zh: 若名級相應者，即於黃素楷書大字，具件階級數，令本曹尚書以朱印印之。
units.en: Where name and rank match, let the full rank and grade be written in large characters on yellow plain silk and sealed in vermilion by the responsible minister.
units.literal: Where names and ranks correspond, then on yellow plain silk write in large regular script the full list of rank levels, and have the Minister of that bureau affix a vermilion seal.

units.zh: 明造兩通，一關吏部，一留兵局，與奏按對掌。
units.en: Two copies should be made explicitly: one filed with Personnel, one kept in the military bureau, each held against the investigation records.
units.literal: Clearly make two copies: one to be filed with the Ministry of Personnel, one kept in the military bureau, each to be held against the submitted investigations.

units.zh: 進則防揩洗之偽，退則無改易之理。
units.en: Henceforth erasure and forgery will be prevented; retroactive alteration will no longer be possible.
units.literal: Going forward this will guard against the fraud of erasure and alteration; looking back, there will be no grounds for changing records.

units.zh: 從前以來，勳書上省，唯列姓名，不載本屬，致令竊濫之徒輕為苟且。
units.en: Hitherto merit documents sent to the capital listed only names, not home jurisdictions, so that fraudsters treated the system casually.
units.literal: From former times until now, when merit documents were sent up to the province, only names were listed and native jurisdictions were not recorded, causing those who stole and abused rank to treat the matter lightly and carelessly.

units.zh: 今請征職白民，具列本州、郡、縣、三長之所；
units.en: Hereafter, for commoners drafted to service, let their home province, commandery, county, and ward under the three-chief system be fully listed;
units.literal: Now I request that for commoners called to service, their original province, commandery, county, and the locality of the three chiefs be fully listed;

units.zh: 其實官正職者，亦列名貫，別錄歷階。
units.en: and for men holding actual regular office, let name and lineage be listed and successive ranks recorded separately.
units.literal: for those who are actual officials in regular posts, also list their name and lineage, and separately record their successive ranks.

units.zh: 仰本軍印記其上，然後印縫各上所司，統將、都督並皆印記，然後列上行臺。
units.en: Let the home army affix its seal first; then, with seals along the fold, copies should go to each responsible office, and the army commander and regional inspector should all seal them before the list is sent to the mobile headquarters.
units.literal: Have the home army stamp and seal upon it, then at the seal seam submit copies to each responsible office; the commanding general and regional inspector shall all affix seals, and only then submit the list to the mobile headquarters.

units.zh: 行臺關太尉，太尉檢練精實，乃始關刺省重究括，然後奏申。
units.en: The mobile headquarters forwards it to the Grand Commandant; once he has verified the facts, it goes to the provincial authorities for thorough review, and only then is it memorialized to the throne.
units.literal: The mobile headquarters forwards it to the Grand Commandant; the Grand Commandant inspects, refines, and verifies the facts, and only then forwards it to the province for thorough re-examination, after which it is memorialized and reported.

units.zh: 奏出之日，黃素朱印，關付吏部。
units.en: On the day the memorial is approved, a yellow register sealed in vermilion is forwarded to the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: On the day the memorial is issued, yellow plain silk with vermilion seal is forwarded to the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 頃來非但偷階冒名，改換勳簿而已，或一階再取，或易名受級，凡如此者，其人不少。
units.en: Recently men have not only stolen rank and usurped names or altered merit registers; some have claimed the same rank twice, or changed names to receive grades—such cases are numerous.
units.literal: Recently it is not only stealing ranks and usurping names and altering merit registers; some take one rank twice, or change names to receive grades—such cases are not few.

units.zh: 良由吏部無簿，防塞失方。
units.en: This is chiefly because Personnel keeps no proper register, so safeguards have failed.
units.literal: This is truly because the Ministry of Personnel has no register, and the means of prevention and blocking have failed.

units.zh: 何者？
units.en: Why?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 吏部加階之後，簿不注記，緣此之故，易生僥倖。
units.en: After Personnel awards a rank, the register is not annotated, and opportunism easily follows.
units.literal: After the Ministry of Personnel adds a rank, the register is not annotated; because of this, opportunism easily arises.

units.zh: 自今敍階之後，名簿具注加補日月，尚書印記，然後付曹。
units.en: Henceforth, whenever a rank is conferred, the register must note the date of the award, be sealed by the minister, and only then passed to the bureau.
units.literal: From now on, after ranks are conferred, the name register shall fully note the date of addition and supplementation, the Minister shall affix a seal, and only then hand it to the bureau.

units.zh: 郎中別作抄目，[1]印記一如尚書，郎中自掌，遞代相付。
units.en: The bureau director shall keep a separate copy register, stamped like the minister's copy, held in his own custody and handed on in rotation.
units.literal: The director shall make a separate copy register, stamped like the Minister's register, which the director keeps in hand and passes on in rotation.

units.zh: 此制一行，差止姦罔。
units.en: Once this system is in force, fraud will largely cease.
units.literal: Once this system is implemented, fraud and deception will largely cease.

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The emperor approved the proposal.
units.literal: An edict approved it.

units.zh: 同又奏曰：
units.en: Tong submitted a further memorial:
units.literal: Tong again memorialized, saying:

units.zh: 臣頃奏以黃素為勳，[2]具注官名、戶屬及吏部換勳之法，事目三條，已蒙旨許。
units.en: I recently proposed using yellow registers for merit records, with full notation of office, household affiliation, and Personnel's rules for altering registers—three measures in all—which Your Majesty has already approved.
units.literal: Your subject recently memorialized using yellow plain silk for merit records, fully noting official names, household affiliation, and the Ministry of Personnel's method for altering merit records—three items in all—which have already received imperial approval.

units.zh: 臣伏思黃素勳簿，政可粗止姦偽，然在軍虛詐，猶未可盡。
units.en: I consider that yellow merit registers can curb forgery in general, yet army-side fraud cannot yet be fully eliminated.
units.literal: Your subject reflects that yellow plain silk merit registers can roughly stop fraud and forgery, yet false claims in the army still cannot be fully ended.

units.zh: 請自今在軍閱簿之日，行臺、軍司、監軍、都督各明立文按，處處記之。
units.en: I ask that from now on, on the day registers are reviewed in camp, the mobile headquarters, army aide, army inspector, and regional inspector each keep explicit written records at every point.
units.literal: I request that from now on, on the day of army muster and register review, the mobile headquarters, army aide, army inspector, and regional inspector each clearly establish written records and note every place.

units.zh: 斬首成一階已上，即令給券。
units.en: Whenever decapitations amount to one full rank of merit or more, a warrant should be issued at once.
units.literal: When decapitations amount to one rank or more, issue a warrant immediately.

units.zh: 一紙之上，當中大書起行臺、統軍位號，勳人甲乙。
units.en: On one sheet, the mobile headquarters and army commander's titles should be written prominently at the center, with the merit-holder's name in sequence.
units.literal: On a single sheet, write prominently in the center the mobile headquarters and army commander's titles, and the merit-holder's name in order.

units.zh: 斬三賊及被傷成階已上，亦具書於券。
units.en: Decapitating three enemies and wounds qualifying for one rank or more should likewise be fully recorded on the warrant.
units.literal: Decapitating three bandits and being wounded to the level of one rank or more should also be fully written on the warrant.

units.zh: 各盡一行，當行豎裂。
units.en: Each entry should fill one line, with a vertical split along that line.
units.literal: Each fills one line; along the line make a vertical split.

units.zh: 其券前後皆起年號日月，破某處陳，某官某勳，印記為驗。
units.en: Both ends of the warrant should bear the reign era date; breaking such-and-such enemy formation, such-and-such officer's such-and-such merit—with seals as proof.
units.literal: At front and back of the warrant begin with reign era year, month, and day; breaking such-and-such place's formation, such-and-such official's such-and-such merit—seals as verification.

units.zh: 一支付勳人，一支付行臺。
units.en: One copy goes to the merit-holder, one to the mobile headquarters.
units.literal: One copy given to the merit-holder, one given to the mobile headquarters.

units.zh: 記至京，即送門下，別函守錄。
units.en: When records reach the capital, they should go at once to the Gate Department, with a separate sealed copy kept on file.
units.literal: When the record reaches the capital, send it immediately to the Gate Department and keep a separate sealed copy on file.

units.zh: 又自遷都以來，戎車屢捷，所以征勳轉多，敍不可盡者，良由歲久生姦，積年長偽，巧吏階緣，偷增遂甚。
units.en: Moreover, since the capital was moved, repeated military victories have multiplied battlefield merit; the backlog of unrewarded merit owes chiefly to years of fraud, long-standing falsification, and clever clerks who exploit connections until illicit claims have grown severe.
units.literal: Moreover, since the move of the capital, war chariots have repeatedly won victories, so battlefield merit has steadily increased; those who cannot all be rewarded are truly because years breed fraud, long accumulation breeds falsehood, and clever clerks climb by connections, so illicit additions have become extreme.

units.zh: 請自今為始，諸有勳簿已經奏賞者，即廣下遠近，云某處勳判，咸令知聞。
units.en: I ask that henceforth, whenever merit registers have been memorialized and rewarded, notice be sent far and wide naming the place and judgment, so that all may know.
units.literal: I request that from now on, wherever merit registers have already been memorialized and rewarded, copies be widely sent near and far, stating such-and-such place's merit judgment, so that all may know.

units.zh: 立格酬敍，以三年為斷。
units.en: Set a rule that rewards must be conferred within three years.
units.literal: Establish a rule for rewarding and conferring ranks, with three years as the limit.

units.zh: 其職人及出身，限內悉令銓除；
units.en: Within that limit, clerical posts and entry-level appointments must all be filled;
units.literal: For clerical personnel and initial appointments, within the limit all are to be evaluated and cleared;

units.zh: 實官及外號，隨才加授。
units.en: regular offices and honorary titles should be granted according to merit and ability.
units.literal: actual offices and external titles are to be granted according to talent.

units.zh: 庶使酬勤者速申，立功者勸，事不經久，僥倖易息。
units.en: Thus the diligent may be rewarded promptly, men of merit encouraged, delays avoided, and opportunism easily suppressed.
units.literal: Thus those repaying diligence may quickly report, those establishing merit may be encouraged, affairs will not drag on for long, and opportunism will easily subside.

units.zh: 或遭窮難，州無中正者，不在此限。
units.en: Cases where hardship prevents evaluation, or a province lacks a Rectifier of the Pure, are excepted.
units.literal: Or if they meet hardship and the province has no Rectifier of the Pure, they are outside this limit.

units.zh: 又勳簿之法，征還之日即應申送。
units.en: Moreover, by merit-register law, registers should be submitted the day the army returns.
units.literal: Moreover, by the law of merit registers, on the day the campaign returns they should be submitted.

units.zh: 頃來行臺、督將，至京始造，或一年二歲方上勳書。
units.en: Recently mobile headquarters and supervising generals have waited until reaching the capital to compile registers, or submitted merit documents only after one or two years.
units.literal: Recently mobile headquarters and supervising generals have waited until reaching the capital to compile them, or only after one or two years submitted merit documents.

units.zh: 姦偽之原，實自由此。
units.en: The root of fraud lies precisely here.
units.literal: The root of fraud and falsehood truly lies in this.

units.zh: 於今以後，軍還之日便通勳簿，不聽隔月。
units.en: Henceforth registers must be transmitted the day the army returns; delay beyond a month will not be allowed.
units.literal: From now on, on the day the army returns the merit register must be transmitted; crossing a month is not permitted.

units.zh: 詔復依行。
units.en: An edict again ordered these measures carried out.
units.literal: An edict again ordered implementation.

units.zh: 元叉之廢靈太后也，相州刺史、中山王熙起兵於鄴。
units.en: When Yuan Cha deposed Empress Dowager Ling, Prince Xi of Zhongshan, who was Inspector of Xiangzhou, raised an army at Ye.
units.literal: When Yuan Cha deposed Empress Dowager Ling, the Inspector of Xiangzhou, Prince Xi of Zhongshan, raised troops at Ye.

units.zh: 熙敗，以同為持節、兼黃門侍郎、慰勞使，乃就州刑熙。
units.en: After Xi's defeat, Tong was appointed Bearer of Credentials and concurrent Yellow Gate Attendant as a comforting envoy; he executed Xi in the province.
units.literal: When Xi was defeated, Tong was made Bearer of Credentials, concurrently Yellow Gate Attendant, and Comforting Envoy; he then executed Xi in the province.

units.zh: 還授平東將軍，正黃門，營明堂副將。
units.en: On returning he was made General Who Pacifies the East, Regular Yellow Gate Attendant, and deputy commander for building the Bright Hall.
units.literal: On his return he was given General Who Pacifies the East, Regular Yellow Gate Attendant, and Deputy Commander for constructing the Bright Hall.

units.zh: 尋加撫軍將軍、光祿大夫、本州大中正。
units.en: He was soon additionally named Army-soothing General, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Grand Rectifier of the Pure for his native province.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was given the additional titles Army-soothing General, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Grand Rectifier of the Pure for his home province.

units.zh: 同善事在位，為叉所親，戮熙之日，深窮黨與，以希叉旨，論者非之。
units.en: Tong knew how to please those in power and was favored by Cha; on the day Xi was killed he pursued associates relentlessly to win Cha's approval, and critics condemned him for it.
units.literal: Tong was skilled at serving those in power and was intimate with Cha; on the day Xi was executed he pursued associates to the depths, hoping to please Cha's intent, and critics condemned him.

units.zh: 又給同羽林二十人以自防衞。
units.en: He was also granted twenty guards of the Forest of Feathers for his protection.
units.literal: He was also given twenty guards of the Forest of Feathers for his own protection.

units.zh: 同兄琇，少多大言，常云「公侯可致」。
units.en: Tong's elder brother Xiu had been boastful since youth, often saying, "Marquisates and dukedoms are within reach."
units.literal: Tong's elder brother Xiu, from youth fond of grand talk, often said, "Marquisates and dukedoms can be attained."

units.zh: 至此始為都水使者。
units.en: Only then did he become Commissioner of the Capital Waterways.
units.literal: Only at this point did he become Commissioner of the Capital Waterways.

units.zh: 同啟求回身二階以加琇，琇遂除安州刺史。
units.en: Tong petitioned to surrender two ranks from his own record for Xiu's benefit; Xiu was then appointed Inspector of Anzhou.
units.literal: Tong memorialized asking to return two ranks from his own person to add to Xiu; Xiu was then appointed Inspector of Anzhou.

units.zh: 論者稱之。
units.en: Commentators praised him for it.
units.literal: Critics praised this.

units.zh: 營州城民就德興謀反，除同度支尚書，黃門如故，持節使營州慰勞，聽以便宜從事。
units.en: When the townspeople of Yingzhou under Jiudexing plotted rebellion, Tong was appointed Minister of the Treasury while retaining his Yellow Gate post; bearing credentials he was sent to console Yingzhou with discretionary authority.
units.literal: The city people of Yingzhou, Jiudexing, plotted rebellion; Tong was appointed Minister of the Treasury, Yellow Gate Attendant as before, bearing credentials as envoy to console Yingzhou, with authority to act as circumstances required.

units.zh: 同頻遣使人，皆為賊害，乃遣賊家口三十人并免家奴為良，齎書諭德興，德興乃降。
units.en: Tong sent envoys repeatedly, but the rebels killed them all; he then sent thirty rebel dependents and freed household slaves to commoner status, carrying a letter to Jiudexing, who then surrendered.
units.literal: Tong repeatedly sent envoys, all of whom were harmed by the rebels; he then sent thirty family members of the rebels and also freed household slaves to commoner status, carrying a letter to instruct Dexing, and Dexing then surrendered.

units.zh: 安輯其民而還。
units.en: He pacified the people and returned.
units.literal: He settled and comforted the people and returned.

units.zh: 德興復反，詔同以本將軍為幽州刺史，兼尚書行臺慰勞之。
units.en: When Jiudexing rebelled again, Tong was ordered to serve as Inspector of Youzhou with his existing general's rank and concurrently as mobile headquarters of the Masters of Writing to console the region.
units.literal: Dexing rebelled again; an edict made Tong, with his existing general's title, Inspector of Youzhou, concurrently Masters of Writing mobile headquarters to console them.

units.zh: 同慮德興難信，勒眾而往，為德興所擊，大敗而還。
units.en: Fearing Jiudexing could not be trusted, Tong marched in force, was attacked and routed, and retreated in defeat.
units.literal: Tong feared Dexing could not be trusted, drove the host forward, was struck by Dexing, suffered a great defeat, and returned.

units.zh: 靈太后反政，以同叉黨，除名。
units.en: When Empress Dowager Ling regained power, Tong was struck from the rolls as a member of Cha's faction.
units.literal: When Empress Dowager Ling regained power, because Tong was counted among Cha's faction, his name was struck from the rolls.

units.zh: 孝昌三年，除左將軍、太中大夫、兼左丞，為齊兗二州行臺，節度大都督李叔仁。
units.en: In the third year of Xiaochang he was appointed Left General, Grand Master of Palace Counsel, and concurrent Left Assistant Director, and served as mobile headquarters over the two provinces of Qi and Yan directing Grand Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren.
units.literal: In the third year of Xiaochang, he was appointed Left General, Grand Master of Palace Counsel, and concurrent Left Assistant Director; he served as mobile headquarters over Qi and the two Yanzhou provinces, directing Grand Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren.

units.zh: 闕莊帝踐祚，詔復本秩，除都官尚書，復兼七兵。
units.en: 〈Missing text〉 When Emperor Zhuang took the throne, an edict restored his former ranks; he was appointed Minister of the Masters of Scrutiny and again concurrently held the Seven Troops bureau.
units.literal: 〈Missing text〉 When Emperor Zhuang took the throne, an edict restored his former ranks; he was appointed Minister of the Masters of Scrutiny and again concurrently held the Seven Troops bureau.

units.zh: 以同前慰勞德興之功，封章武縣開國伯，邑四百戶。
units.en: For Tong's earlier service in pacifying Jiudexing, he was enfeoffed as founding baron of Zhangwu County with a fief of four hundred households.
units.literal: For Tong's earlier achievement in comforting Dexing, he was enfeoffed as Baron Who Founded Zhangwu County, with a fief of four hundred households.

units.zh: 正除七兵，尋轉殿中，加征南將軍。
units.en: He was formally appointed to the Seven Troops bureau; soon afterward he was transferred to the Palace Attendants and additionally named General Who Campaigns South.
units.literal: He was formally appointed to the Seven Troops bureau; shortly afterward he was transferred to the Palace Attendants and given the additional title General Who Campaigns South.

units.zh: 普泰初，除侍中，進號驃騎將軍、左光祿大夫。
units.en: At the opening of the Putai reign he was appointed Palace Attendant and advanced to General of Fast Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
units.literal: At the beginning of Putai, he was appointed Palace Attendant and advanced to General of Fast Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

units.zh: 同時久病，強牽從務，啟乞儀同。
units.en: Tong had long been ill but was forcibly pressed to continue in office; he memorialized requesting the honorific rank of Yitong.
units.literal: At the same time Tong had long been ill but was forcibly pressed into service; he memorialized requesting the honorific rank of Yitong.

units.zh: 初同之為黃門也，與前廢帝俱在門下，同異其為人，素相款託。
units.en: Earlier, when Tong served in the Yellow Gate, he and the Deposed Former Emperor were both in the Gate Department; Tong admired his character and they had long been on intimate terms.
units.literal: Earlier, when Tong served in the Yellow Gate, he and the Deposed Former Emperor were both in the Gate Department; Tong was impressed by his character and they had long been on friendly terms.

units.zh: 廢帝以恩舊許之，除儀同三司，餘官如故。
units.en: The Deposed Emperor granted it out of old friendship; Tong was given Yitong Third Rank, his other offices remaining unchanged.
units.literal: The Deposed Emperor, out of old friendship, granted it; Tong was given Yitong Third Rank, his other offices remaining as before.

units.zh: 永熙初薨，年五十六。
units.en: At the opening of the Yongxi reign he died at the age of fifty-six.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yongxi he died, aged fifty-six.

units.zh: 贈侍中、都督冀滄瀛三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、司空公、冀州刺史，開國伯如故，賜帛四百匹，諡曰孝穆。
units.en: Posthumously he was given Palace Attendant, command over the military affairs of Ji, Cang, and Ying provinces, Grand General of Fast Cavalry, Duke of the Works, and Inspector of Jizhou; his founding barony was unchanged; four hundred bolts of silk were granted; his posthumous title was Xiaomu.
units.literal: Posthumously he was given Palace Attendant, Commander-in-Chief of the military affairs of Ji, Cang, and Ying provinces, Grand General of Fast Cavalry, Duke of the Works, and Inspector of Jizhou; his founding barony remained as before; four hundred bolts of silk were granted; his posthumous title was Xiaomu.

units.zh: 三年，復加贈尚書右僕射。
units.en: Three years later he was again posthumously given Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Three years later he was again posthumously given Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 有四子。
units.en: He had four sons.
units.literal: He had four sons.

units.zh: 長子斐，武定中，文襄王大將軍府掾。
units.en: His eldest son Fei, during the Wuding era, served as an aide in Grand General Wen Xiang Wang's headquarters.
units.literal: His eldest son Fei, in the Wuding era, was an aide in Grand General Wen Xiang's headquarters.

units.zh: 斐弟筠，青州治中。
units.en: Fei's younger brother Jun served as Administrative Aide of Qingzhou.
units.literal: Fei's younger brother Jun was Administrative Aide of Qingzhou.

units.zh: 同兄靜，太常丞。
units.en: Tong's elder brother Jing was Assistant Director of the Chamberlain for Ceremonials.
units.literal: Tong's elder brother Jing was Assistant in the Chamberlain for Ceremonials.

units.zh: 靜子景裕，在儒林傳。
units.en: Jing's son Jingyu is treated in the biography of Confucian scholars.
units.literal: Jing's son Jingyu is treated in the Confucian Scholars biography.

units.zh: 張烈，字徽仙，清河東武城人也。
units.en: Zhang Lie, whose style name was Huixian, came from Dongwucheng in Qinghe.
units.literal: Zhang Lie, style name Huixian, was a man of Dongwucheng in Qinghe.

units.zh: 高祖賜名曰烈，仍以本名為字焉。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu gave him the name Lie, while his original name served as his style name.
units.literal: Emperor Gaozu bestowed the name Lie upon him, yet still used his original name as his style name.

units.zh: 高祖悕，為慕容 尚書右僕射。
units.en: His great-great-grandfather Xi served the Murong as Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: His great-great-grandfather Xi was Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing under the Murong.

units.zh: 曾祖恂，散騎常侍，隨慕容德南渡，因居齊郡之臨淄。
units.en: His great-grandfather Xun was Regular Attendant of the Cavalry; he followed Murong De south across the Yangzi and settled at Linzi in Qi Commandery.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Xun was Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, followed Murong De south across the river, and thus settled at Linzi in Qi Commandery.

units.zh: 烈少孤貧，涉獵經史，有氣概。
units.en: Lie was orphaned and poor in youth, read widely in the classics and histories, and possessed force of character.
units.literal: Lie from youth was orphaned and poor, ranged through the classics and histories, and had spirit and force of character.

units.zh: 時青州有崔徽伯、房徽叔，與烈並有令譽，時人號曰「三徽」。
units.en: At that time Qingzhou had Cui Huibo and Fang Huishu; they and Lie all enjoyed fine reputations, and contemporaries called them "the Three Huis."
units.literal: At that time in Qingzhou were Cui Huibo and Fang Huishu; together with Lie they all had fine reputations, and men of the time called them "the Three Huis."

units.zh: 高祖時，入官代都，歷侍御、主文中散。
units.en: During Gaozu's reign he entered service at the capital in Dai, serving as Attendant Censor and Regular Attendant of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: In Emperor Gaozu's time he entered office at the capital in Dai, passing through Attendant Censor and Regular Attendant of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 遷洛，除尚書儀曹郎、彭城王功曹史、太子步兵校尉。
units.en: After the move to Luoyang he was appointed Master of Writing in the Ceremonials Bureau, Merit Officer to the Prince of Pengcheng, and Commandant of Footsoldiers to the Crown Prince.
units.literal: When the capital moved to Luoyang, he was appointed Master of Writing in the Ceremonials Bureau, Merit Officer of the Prince of Pengcheng, and Crown Prince's Commandant of Footsoldiers.

units.zh: 蕭寶卷將陳顯達治兵漢南，謀將入寇。
units.en: Chen Xianda, a general of Xiao Baojuan of Qi, drilled troops south of the Han and planned an invasion.
units.literal: Xiao Baojuan's general Chen Xianda drilled troops south of the Han, plotting to invade.

units.zh: 時順陽太守王青石世官江南，荊州刺史、廣陽王嘉慮其有異，表請代之。
units.en: The Grand Administrator of Shunyang, Wang Qingshi, came from a family long established south of the Yangzi; Prince Jia of Guangyang, Inspector of Jingzhou, suspected his loyalty and memorialized for his replacement.
units.literal: At that time the Grand Administrator of Shunyang, Wang Qingshi, had for generations held office south of the Yangzi; the Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince Jia of Guangyang, feared he was disloyal and memorialized requesting a replacement.

units.zh: 高祖詔侍臣各舉所知，互有申薦者。
units.en: Gaozu ordered his attendant ministers each to recommend someone they knew, and several names were put forward.
units.literal: Emperor Gaozu ordered the attendant ministers each to recommend men they knew, and several offered nominations.

units.zh: 高祖曰：「此郡今當必爭之地，須得堪濟之才，何容汎舉也。
units.en: Gaozu said, "This commandery is certain to become a battleground; it requires talent equal to the task—how could one put forward names at random?
units.literal: Emperor Gaozu said, "This commandery is now certain to become contested ground; it requires talent equal to the task—how could one put forward names at random?

units.zh: 太子步兵張烈每論軍國之事，時有會人意處，朕欲用之，何如？」
units.en: The Crown Prince's Commandant of Footsoldiers Zhang Lie, whenever he discusses military and state affairs, often hits the mark; I wish to employ him—what do you think?"
units.literal: The Crown Prince's Commandant of Footsoldiers Zhang Lie, whenever he discusses military and state affairs, often hits the point; We wish to employ him—what do you think?"

units.zh: 彭城王勰稱贊之，遂敕除陵江將軍、順陽太守。
units.en: The Prince of Pengcheng, Xie, praised him, and an edict appointed him General Who Crosses the Jiang and Grand Administrator of Shunyang.
units.literal: The Prince of Pengcheng, Xie, praised him, and an edict thereupon appointed him General Who Crosses the Jiang and Grand Administrator of Shunyang.

units.zh: 烈到郡二日，便為寶卷將崔慧景攻圍，七十餘日，烈撫厲將士，甚得軍人之和。
units.en: Two days after Lie reached the commandery, he was besieged by Cui Huijing, a general of Xiao Baojuan; for more than seventy days Lie rallied his troops and won their wholehearted loyalty.
units.literal: Lie had been in the commandery two days when he was besieged by Baojuan's general Cui Huijing; for more than seventy days Lie comforted and encouraged the troops, winning great harmony among the soldiers.

units.zh: 會車駕南討，慧景遁走。
units.en: When the emperor marched south in person, Huijing fled.
units.literal: It happened that the imperial carriage marched south to attack, and Huijing fled.

units.zh: 高祖親勞烈曰：「卿定可，遂能不負所寄。」
units.en: Gaozu personally congratulated Lie, saying, "You have proved yourself capable and have not betrayed the trust I placed in you."
units.literal: Emperor Gaozu personally comforted Lie, saying, "You are certainly capable and have not failed the trust placed in you."

units.zh: 烈拜謝曰：「若不值鑾輿親駕，臣將不免困於犬羊。
units.en: Lie bowed and replied, "Had Your Majesty not come in person, I would surely have been overrun by the enemy like a flock of beasts.
units.literal: Lie bowed in thanks and said, "Had I not met the imperial carriage's personal campaign, your subject would not have escaped being trapped by dogs and sheep.

units.zh: 自是陛下不負臣，非臣能不負陛下。」
units.en: It is Your Majesty who has not failed me—not that I could claim never to have failed Your Majesty."
units.literal: From this it is Your Majesty who has not failed your subject, not that your subject could fail to fail Your Majesty."

units.zh: 高祖善其對。
units.en: Gaozu was pleased with his answer.
units.literal: Emperor Gaozu approved his reply.

units.zh: 世宗即位，追錄先勳，封清河縣開國子，邑二百戶。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong ascended the throne, he recognized Lie's earlier merit and enfeoffed him as founding viscount of Qinghe County with a fief of two hundred households.
units.literal: When Emperor Shizong took the throne, he recorded former merit and enfeoffed him as Viscount Who Founded the State of Qinghe, with a fief of two hundred households.

units.zh: 尋以母老歸養。
units.en: He soon retired to care for his aged mother.
units.literal: Shortly afterward, because his mother was old, he returned home to support her.

units.zh: 積十餘年，頻值凶儉，烈為粥以食飢人，蒙濟者甚眾，鄉黨以此稱之。
units.en: For more than ten years he lived through repeated famines; Lie made gruel to feed the hungry, relieving a great many people, and his neighbors praised him for it.
units.literal: Over more than ten years he frequently met with famine and dearth; Lie made gruel to feed the hungry, and those who received relief were very many; his village and district praised him for this.

units.zh: 肅宗初，除龍驤將軍、司徒右長史。
units.en: At the start of Emperor Suzong's reign he was appointed Dragon Cavalry General and Right Chief Clerk under the Minister of Education.
units.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Suzong's reign he was appointed Dragon Cavalry General and Right Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education.

units.zh: 又轉征虜將軍、司空長史。
units.en: He was later transferred to General Who Campaigns Against the Barbarians and Chief Clerk under the Minister of Works.
units.literal: He was again transferred to General Who Campaigns Against the Barbarians and Chief Clerk of the Minister of Works.

units.zh: 先是，元叉父江陽王繼曾為青州刺史，及叉當權，烈託故義之懷，遂相諂附。
units.en: Earlier, Yuan Cha's father, Prince Ji of Jiangyang, had served as Inspector of Qingzhou; when Cha came to power, Lie invoked their old ties and attached himself to him with flattery.
units.literal: Earlier, Yuan Cha's father Prince Ji of Jiangyang had once been Inspector of Qingzhou; when Cha held power, Lie relied on their old bond of righteousness and thus flattered and attached himself to him.

units.zh: 除前將軍、給事黃門侍郎，尋加平南將軍、光祿大夫。
units.en: He was appointed Forward General and Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, and soon additionally named General Who Pacifies the South and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
units.literal: He was appointed Forward General and Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, and shortly given the additional titles General Who Pacifies the South and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

units.zh: 後靈太后反政，以烈叉黨，出為鎮東將軍、青州刺史。
units.en: When Empress Dowager Ling later regained power, Lie was sent out as General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Qingzhou because he was counted among Cha's faction.
units.literal: Later, when Empress Dowager Ling regained power, because Lie was counted among Cha's faction, he was sent out as General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Qingzhou.

units.zh: 于時議者以烈家產畜殖，僮客甚多，慮其怨望，不宜出為本州，改授安北將軍、瀛州刺史。
units.en: Critics at the time noted that Lie's household wealth and retinue had grown large and feared he might harbor resentment if sent to his home province; he was instead appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Yingzhou.
units.literal: At that time critics, because Lie's household wealth and livestock had multiplied and his retainers were many, feared he harbored resentment and that he should not be sent out to his home province; he was instead given General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Yingzhou.

units.zh: 為政清靜，吏民安之。
units.en: His administration was quiet and orderly, and officials and commoners alike were content.
units.literal: His governance was pure and tranquil, and officials and people were at ease.

units.zh: 更滿還朝，因辭老還鄉里。
units.en: When his term ended he returned to court, then retired to his home district on grounds of age.
units.literal: When his term ended he returned to court, then citing old age went back to his home district.

units.zh: 兄弟同居怡怡然，為親類所慕。
units.en: The brothers lived together in harmony and were admired by their kin.
units.literal: The brothers lived together in easy contentment and were admired by kin.

units.zh: 元象元年，卒於家，時年七十七。
units.en: In the first year of the Yuanxiang era he died at home at the age of seventy-seven.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang he died at home, aged seventy-seven.

units.zh: 烈先為家誡千餘言，并自敍志行及所歷之官，臨終敕子姪不聽求贈，但勒家誡立碣而已。
units.en: Lie had earlier composed more than a thousand words of family admonitions and recorded his aims, conduct, and offices; on his deathbed he forbade his sons and nephews to seek posthumous honors and asked only that the admonitions be carved on a stele.
units.literal: Lie had earlier written more than a thousand words of family admonitions and also narrated his aims, conduct, and offices held; on his deathbed he ordered his sons and nephews not to seek posthumous honors, but only to inscribe the family admonitions on a stele.

units.zh: 其子質奉行焉。
units.en: His son Zhi obeyed these instructions.
units.literal: His son Zhi carried this out.

units.zh: 質，博學多才藝。
units.en: Zhi was learned and gifted in many arts.
units.literal: Zhi was broadly learned and skilled in many arts.

units.zh: 解褐奉朝請，員外郎、龍驤將軍、諫議大夫。
units.en: On entering office he served as Court Gentleman for Attendance, Extraordinary Master of Writing, Dragon Cavalry General, and Grand Master of Remonstrance.
units.literal: On leaving the cloth he became Court Gentleman for Attendance, Extraordinary Master of Writing, Dragon Cavalry General, and Grand Master of Remonstrance.

units.zh: 未襲爵。
units.en: He did not inherit his father's title.
units.literal: He did not inherit the enfeoffment.

units.zh: 興和中，卒於家。
units.en: During the Xinghe era he died at home.
units.literal: In the Xinghe era he died at home.

units.zh: 質弟登，州主簿。
units.en: Zhi's younger brother Deng served as Provincial Recorder.
units.literal: Zhi's younger brother Deng was Provincial Recorder.

units.zh: 烈弟僧晧，字山客。
units.en: Lie's younger brother Senghao, whose style name was Shanke.
units.literal: Lie's younger brother Senghao, style name Shanke.

units.zh: 歷涉羣書，工於談說，有名於當世。
units.en: He read widely, excelled at conversation, and enjoyed a reputation in his day.
units.literal: He ranged through many books, was skilled at discourse, and had a name in his age.

units.zh: 熙平初，徵為諫議大夫。
units.en: At the opening of the Xiping reign he was summoned as Grand Master of Remonstrance.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xiping he was summoned as Grand Master of Remonstrance.

units.zh: 正光五年，以國子博士徵之。
units.en: In the fifth year of Zhengguang he was summoned as Erudite of the Imperial Academy.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengguang he was summoned as Erudite of the Imperial Academy.

units.zh: 孝昌二年，徵為散騎侍郎。
units.en: In the second year of Xiaochang he was summoned as Attendant Cavalryman.
units.literal: In the second year of Xiaochang he was summoned as Attendant Cavalryman.

units.zh: 並不赴。
units.en: He declined every summons.
units.literal: He did not go to any of them.

units.zh: 世號為徵君焉。
units.en: Contemporaries called him the Recluse Lord.
units.literal: His age called him the Recluse Lord.

units.zh: 好營產業，孜孜不已，藏鏹巨萬，他資亦稱是。
units.en: He loved amassing property and worked tirelessly; his hoarded cash ran to tens of thousands, with other assets to match.
units.literal: He loved building up estates and worked tirelessly without cease; his stored cash amounted to tens of thousands, and his other assets were comparable.

units.zh: 兄弟自供儉約，車馬瘦弊，身服布裳，而婢妾紈綺。
units.en: The brothers lived frugally themselves—their carriages and horses were shabby, they wore plain cloth, yet their maidservants and concubines dressed in silk brocade.
units.literal: The brothers themselves lived frugally; their carriages and horses were lean and worn, they wore cloth garments, yet their maidservants and concubines wore silk brocades.

units.zh: 僧晧尤好蒲弈，戲不擇人，是以獲譏於世。
units.en: Senghao was especially fond of playing bo and would play with anyone, for which he was ridiculed.
units.literal: Senghao especially loved playing bo, and in play did not choose his opponents, for which he was mocked by the world.

units.zh: 前廢帝時，崔祖螭舉兵攻東陽城，僧晧與同。
units.en: Under the Deposed Former Emperor, when Cui Zuchi raised troops against Dongyang, Senghao joined the rebellion.
units.literal: In the time of the Deposed Former Emperor, Cui Zuchi raised troops and attacked Dongyang city; Senghao joined him.

units.zh: 事敗，死於獄，籍沒家產。
units.en: When the plot failed he died in prison and his estate was confiscated.
units.literal: When the affair failed he died in prison and his household property was confiscated.

units.zh: 出帝初，訴復業。
units.en: At the start of Emperor Chu's reign his family appealed and recovered their property.
units.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Chu's reign, through appeal his estate was restored.

units.zh: 子軌，州主簿。
units.en: His son Gui served as Provincial Recorder.
units.literal: His son Gui was Provincial Recorder.

units.zh: 史臣曰：盧同質器洪厚，卷舒兼濟。
units.en: The historian writes: Lu Tong possessed a broad and weighty character, able to adapt whether advancing or withdrawing.
units.literal: The historian says: Lu Tong's native substance was broad and deep, able both to advance and to withdraw as the times required.

units.zh: 張烈早標名輩，氣尚見知。
units.en: Zhang Lie early distinguished himself among notable men, and his bearing won esteem.
units.literal: Zhang Lie early marked himself among famous men, and his spirit and bearing won recognition.

units.zh: 趨捨深沉，俱至顯達，雅道正路，其殆病諸。
units.en: Both pursued their ambitions with subtle calculation and reached high office—yet on the path of true refinement, this may be where they fell short.
units.literal: Their choices in advance and retreat were deep and hidden; both reached eminence—yet on the refined path and upright road, this is perhaps where they fell ill.

units.zh: 校勘記
units.en: Collation Notes
units.literal: Collation Notes

units.zh: 郎中別作抄目 諸本「目」訛「自」，不可通，今據北史卷三０盧同傳改。
units.en: Regarding "the director shall make a separate copy register": various editions wrongly read "register" (mu) as "self" (zi), which is unintelligible; the text is corrected here according to Lu Tong's biography in juan 30 of the History of the Northern Dynasties.
units.literal: On "the director shall make a separate copy register": in various editions "register" (mu) is wrongly written as "self" (zi), which makes no sense; the text is now corrected according to the biography of Lu Tong in juan 30 of the History of the Northern Dynasties.

units.zh: 臣頃奏以黃素為勳 按「勳」下當脫「簿」字，下云「黃素勳簿」可證。
units.en: Regarding "I recently memorialized using yellow plain silk for merit": the word "register" (bu) is missing after "merit," as shown by the phrase "yellow merit register" below.
units.literal: On "Your subject recently memorialized using yellow plain silk for merit": under "merit" the character "register" (bu) is missing; the phrase "yellow plain silk merit register" below proves this.

units.zh: 節度大都督李叔仁
units.en: Grand Commander-in-Chief and Controller Li Shuren
units.literal: Grand Commander-in-Chief and Controller Li Shuren

units.en: 〈Missing text〉
units.literal: 〈Missing〉

units.zh: 諸本下旁注「闕」字。
units.en: Various editions carry a marginal note reading "missing."
units.literal: Various editions have a marginal note reading "missing."

units.zh: 按卷九肅宗紀孝昌三年二月庚申稱東郡民趙顯德反，詔都督李叔仁討之；
units.en: According to juan 9 of Emperor Suzong's annals, on gengshen day in the second month of the third year of Xiaochang, the people of Dong Commandery under Zhao Xiande rebelled, and an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren to suppress them;
units.literal: According to juan 9 of the Annals of Emperor Suzong, in the third year of Xiaochang, second month, day gengshen, it says the people of Dong Commandery under Zhao Xiande rebelled and an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren to attack them;

units.zh: 三月辛未又稱齊州廣川民劉鈞執清河太守邵懷聚眾反，六月稱詔都督李叔仁討劉鈞平之。
units.en: on xinwei day in the third month it records that Liu Jun of Guangchuan in Qizhou seized Grand Administrator Shao Huai of Qinghe and raised a rebellion; in the sixth month an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren to attack Liu Jun and pacify him.
units.literal: third month, day xinwei, it again says the people of Guangchuan in Qizhou, Liu Jun, seized the Grand Administrator of Qinghe, Shao Huai, gathered a host and rebelled; sixth month says an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren to attack Liu Jun and pacify him.

units.zh: 東郡屬西兗州。
units.en: Dong Commandery belonged to West Yanzhou.
units.literal: Dong Commandery belonged to West Yanzhou.

units.zh: 盧同以齊兗二州行臺節度李叔仁，所闕必即鎮壓這兩支變亂軍事，但紀不書盧同以行臺節度事。
units.en: Lu Tong, as mobile headquarters over Qi and the two Yanzhou provinces, directed Li Shuren; the missing passage must concern the suppression of these two rebellions, though the annals do not record Tong's role as mobile headquarters commander.
units.literal: Lu Tong, as mobile headquarters of Qi and Yanzhou, controlled Li Shuren; what is missing must be the suppression of these two rebellions, yet the annals do not record Lu Tong's role as mobile headquarters controller.
